overview: The paper investigates how reinforcement learning after next-token prediction enables autoregressive models to generalize on challenging tasks using mixture distributions of rare long (chain-of-thought) and short sequences, theoretically and empirically showing that RL effectively up-samples correct long demonstrations leading to length increase and learning efficiency.

modules.name: Parity Data Distribution Generator
modules.description: Generates synthetic datasets for the parity task based on the mixture distribution D(pcot), producing input bits and output sequences that are either short (direct answer) or long (step-by-step CoT), including support for noisy labels and partial CoT variations.

modules.name: Arithmetic Data Distribution Generator
modules.description: Generates synthetic datasets for number multiplication tasks, formatting sequences to include the execution trace of the grade-school algorithm (long format) or just the problem and answer (short format), with controllable mixture coefficients.

modules.name: Math Reasoning Data Processor
modules.description: Processes mathematical reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH) to structure data with specific thinking and answer tags, implementing the logic to drop the chain-of-thought with a specified probability to create mixed training datasets for Llama models.

modules.name: Theoretical Linear Autoregressive Model
modules.description: Implements the linear autoregressive architecture used in the theoretical analysis, consisting of a series of linear predictors with specific polynomial feature embeddings and a decision mechanism for halting (EOS) vs. continuing generation.

modules.name: Transformer Model Interface
modules.description: Wrapper for autoregressive transformer architectures (GPT-2, Mistral) handling configuration initialization, embedding layers, and forward pass logic for next-token prediction tasks.

modules.name: Reward Functions Module
modules.description: Implements the binary and continuous reward functions for reinforcement learning, including end-to-end correctness (checking only the final answer), chain-of-thought correctness (checking the entire sequence validity), and step-wise math rewards with length penalties.

modules.name: RL Sampler and Generator
modules.description: Manages the generation of model responses during the post-training phase (rollouts), supporting multiple samples per input, variable generation temperatures, and enforcing evaluation mode to ensure deterministic sampling logic for the policy gradient updates.

modules.name: STaR Algorithm Implementation
modules.description: Implements the Self-Taught Reasoner algorithm logic, which involves generating samples, filtering out those with zero reward, and fine-tuning the model on the remaining successful samples using the next-token prediction loss.

modules.name: Policy Gradient Algorithms Implementation
modules.description: Implements the REINFORCE and GRPO algorithms, including the calculation of advantage functions, normalized rewards, and the clipping mechanisms for the ratio of new to old policy probabilities.

modules.name: Pre-training Engine
modules.description: Executes the standard next-token prediction training loop with regularization, supporting online data sampling (fresh batches per iteration) and offline datasets, managing the optimization of the cross-entropy loss.

modules.name: Evaluation and Metrics Engine
modules.description: Calculates model performance metrics including test accuracy under greedy decoding and sampling, distribution of generation lengths, and probability of generating long sequences versus short sequences.

modules.name: Parity Experiment Runner
modules.description: Orchestrates the end-to-end experimental pipeline for the parity task, managing the sequential execution of pre-training and post-training phases while varying input dimensions, mixture coefficients, and model checkpoints.

modules.name: Math Benchmark Experiment Runner
modules.description: Orchestrates the fine-tuning and RL pipeline for mathematical benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH), handling the supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained Llama models followed by the GRPO post-training phase.

modules.name: Theoretical Threshold and Calibration Analyzer
modules.description: Utilities for computing and verifying the theoretical critical thresholds (e.g., the 1/3 boundary for mixture coefficients) and analyzing the calibration of the model's generation length probability against the training distribution statistics.

modules.name: Visualization and Analysis Module
modules.description: Generates plots for accuracy curves during pre-training and post-training, evolution of response length over RL iterations, sample complexity gaps between training paradigms, and qualitative examples of model completions.
